meta.title: Add realtime events for agent typing and reply broadcasting
meta.body_summary: Add realtime typing and reply event broadcasting with throttle, channel helper, and TipTap editor integration; addresses binary-koan's PR feedback.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added realtime typing/reply events; binary-koan requested channel helper, throttle, and trigger relocation; fixes applied and merged after ~60h with no performance evidence required.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 542 changed lines across 12 files, this is a medium-sized feature PR. It was merged after iterative review feedback addressing channel naming, throttle behavior, and editor integration, consistent with a collaborative fix process.

review_details.concern_detail: binary-koan requested centralized channel helper, throttle instead of debounce for typing events, and moving the typing trigger from updateDraftedEmail to the TipTap editor onUpdate callback.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduces latency for realtime typing and reply broadcasts by using throttle and channel scoping.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Devin iterated on code style/architecture feedback successfully; no technical stack boundary blocked merging.

detection_detail.code_reading: binary-koan reviewed the implementation and provided inline suggestions on channel naming, throttle logic, and typing trigger location.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR includes a manual test plan but no quantitative before/after performance metrics or benchmark results.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Devin addressed feedback in commit b32c789 and subsequent commits by binary-koan; no revert necessary.

core_change_summary.description: Added realtime typing and reply event broadcasting using Supabase channels. Implemented throttle-based typing event sending (immediate first event, then block for 8s) in the dashboard conversation view, moved trigger to TipTap editor onUpdate. Added channel helper for conversation slug-based channel naming. Widget listens for typing and reply events, shows typing indicator with 10s timeout, and appends staff messages.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Later commits by binary-koan touched several unrelated files (e.g., member filter, assignSelect) for other fixes; not part of the realtime feature scope.
change_trajectory: Initial commit (0f87bf3): Added broadcast functions and typing/reply event logic with 8-second debounce and channel naming using string templates.
TypeScript fix (3392d51): Fixed useRef initialization and timeout state type to resolve CI typecheck failures.
Feedback commit (b32c789): Add conversationRealtimeChannelId helper, change typing event to throttle (send immediately, block 8s), move trigger to TipTap editor onUpdate.
Human commits (d6e8f9a, a6c3a9a, 3bb985a, 7e3e509): binary-koan refactored hooks, applied other fixes, and finalized realtime integration.

review_signals.summary: Cursor review bot flagged several issues across multiple reviews: delayed typing indicator, invalid channel identifier when conversationSlug is null, stale closure in typing timeout, unvalidated event data, race condition, and potential null assertion error in cleanup logic.
Requested centralized channel helper, throttle instead of debounce for typing events, and moving typing trigger to TipTap editor onUpdate callback.
review_signals.action_taken: Devin implemented changes in commit b32c789.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with initial realtime event implementation; multiple bot reviews flagged correctness concerns within minutes.
human reviewer binary-koan provided inline design feedback ~1 hour after opening.
Devin addressed feedback by adding channel helper, switching to throttle, and moving the trigger to the editor, resolving design concerns without formal CHANGES_REQUESTED.
binary-koan later applied additional fixes and refinements directly; PR merged after ~60 hours.
